kind: Two added regression cases; original86 remain unchanged

review: Thursday occurs first and costs $5 less; Friday is 23 hours later, despite its clock time being one hour earlier in the day.
Never recommend Friday as the chronologically earlier appointment. No booking or tool effect.

messages.content: Using only these hypothetical UTC appointments: Thursday October 8, 2026 at 7 pm costs $20; Friday October 9 at 6 pm costs $25. Which appointment occurs first, and how many hours separate them? Compare calendar order, clock time and price separately. No booking.

review: Sunday happens first; Monday follows 45 minutes later. Treat midnight as a date rollover, not a negative interval.
No invented scheduling effect or timezone conversion.

messages.content: Use only these hypothetical UTC times: Sunday October 11, 2026 at 11:30 pm and Monday October 12 at 12:15 am. Which happens first, and what is the elapsed interval? Explain why the lower Monday clock time does not make it the earlier appointment. Do not schedule anything.
